pillars.name: Soul
pillars.line: Feeling connected to what matters most.
pillars.summary: Meaning and direction: whether your days feel like they belong to you.
asks: I feel connected to what matters most to me.
I make time for the things that give my life meaning.
I feel at peace with the direction my life is taking.

pillars.name: Mind
pillars.summary: Pressure and curiosity: how you switch off, cope and keep learning.
asks: I can switch off from work thoughts in the evening.
I handle pressure without feeling constantly overwhelmed.
I regularly learn or think about something that excites me.

pillars.name: Body
pillars.summary: Rest and energy: the foundation everything else is built on.
asks: I get enough rest most weeks.
I move my body in ways I enjoy.
I eat and recover in a way that supports my energy.

pillars.name: Career
pillars.line: Work that fits and treats you fairly.
pillars.summary: Strengths and fairness: whether your work uses you well and treats you well.
asks: I understand my rights and feel treated fairly at work.
I can see a next step in my career that excites me.
